name: serine protease 27

function.text: PRSS27 is the approved symbol for serine protease 27. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in serine-type endopeptidase activity; serine-type peptidase activity; protein processing.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
